## GOVERNMENT OF ANDHRAPRADESH
ABSTRACT

YAT&C (Sports & Youth Services) Department – Sports Policy 2024-29 -
Implementation of three percent (3%) horizontal reservation to eligible meritorious
sportspersons of Andhra Pradesh in Direct Recruitment without the requirement of
competitive examinations across Government Departments, Local Bodies, Public
Sector Undertakings (PSUs) and Uniformed Services including the Police, Excise and
Forest Departments – Guidelines– Notification – Orders- Issued.

YOUTH ADVANCEMENT, TOURISM & CULTURE (Sports & Youth Services) DEPARTMENT

G.O.MS.No. 4

Dated: 19-04-2025
Read the following:-

1. G.O.Ms.No.74 YAT&C(Sports) Department dt.09.08.2012.
2. G.O.Ms.No.8 YAT&C(Sports) Department dt.23.11.2020.
3. G.O.Ms.No.18 YAT&C (Sports & YS) Department dt:10.12.2024.
4. From the Vice Chairman & Managing Director, Sports Authority of Andhra
Pradesh, Vijayawada, Lr.No.SAAP/Sports Policy 24-29/ASSN/2738100/
2025, dt:04.03.2025 & 05.04.2025.
5. From the Secretary, Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission,
Lr.No.113/R&R/2025, Dated:17.04.2025.
6. From the Vice Chairman & Managing Director, Sports Authority of
Andhra Pradesh, Vijayawada, Lr.No.SAAP/Sports Policy-24-29/ASSN/
2738100/2025, Dt:17.04.2025
*****

******

## ORDER:

In the GO 3ʳᵈ read above, the Government of Andhra Pradesh issued the
Sports Policy 2024-29, aimed at fostering sports development in the state by
establishing world-class infrastructure, nurturing talent and ensuring accessibility for
all. The policy aspires to position Swarna Andhra Pradesh as the Nation's sports
capital and a global centre for sports talent and innovation by 2029.

2. The policy provides a three percent (3%) horizontal reservation in direct
recruitment across Government Departments, Local Bodies, Public Sector
Undertakings (PSUs) and Uniformed Services, including the Police, Excise and Forest
Departments, for eligible meritorious sportspersons of Andhra Pradesh ensuring their
recruitment without the requirement of competitive examinations.

3. The Vice Chairman & Managing Director(VC&MD), Sports Authority of Andhra
Pradesh(SAAP), vide references 4ᵗʰ and 6ᵗʰ read above, has submitted a proposal,
along with draft guidelines, for implementation of three percent (3%) horizontal
reservation for eligible meritorious sportspersons of Andhra Pradesh in direct
recruitment without the requirement of competitive examinations across
Government Departments, Local Bodies, Public Sector Undertakings(PSUs) and
Uniformed Services, including the Police, Excise, and Forest Departments and
requested the Government to issue necessary orders for effective implementation of
the Sports Policy 2024-29.

(Contd...Pg.2)

-2-

4. After careful examination of the matter, and in supersession of the orders
issued in references 1ˢᵗ and 2ⁿᵈ read above, Government hereby issue guidelines in
the Notification for the implementation of three percent (3%) horizontal reservation
for eligible meritorious sportspersons of Andhra Pradesh in direct recruitment
without the requirement of competitive examinations across Government
Departments, Local Bodies, Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) and Uniformed
Services, including the Police, Excise, and Forest Departments.

5. The following Notification shall be published in the Andhra Pradesh Gazette.

## NOTIFICATION

In pursuance of the Sports Policy issued in G.O.Ms.No.18, Youth
Advancement Tourism and Culture (Sports & Youth Services) Department,
dated:10-12-2024, wherein orders were issued for providing a three percent (3%)
horizontal reservation for eligible meritorious sportspersons of Andhra Pradesh in
direct recruitment across Government Departments, Local Bodies, Public Sector
Undertakings (PSUs) and Uniformed Services, including the Police, Excise, and
Forest Departments, ensuring their recruitment without the requirement of
competitive examinations, the following guidelines are issued for governing such
appointments.

This Notification shall be deemed to have come into force with effect on and
from the date of issuance of the Sports Policy 2024-29. It shall remain in force for a
period of five (5) years or till a new Policy is formulated.

1. I. Guidelines
3. a. The Recruitment of eligible meritorious sportspersons under three percent (3%) sports quota as horizontal reservation will be based on the Notifications issued by Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC)/Selection Board/Department concerned, without written examinations, and shall be appointed by the Department concerned, based on the final merit list approved by the State Level Committee.
5. b. The three percent (3%) horizontal reservation in direct recruitment under sports quota shall apply to all the Government Departments, Local Bodies, Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) & Uniformed Services, including the Police, Excise and Forest Departments.
7. c. Criteria for deciding the eligible meritorious sportspersons: -
9. i. The sports disciplines mentioned at Serial No. VI of this order are the list of Recognized Sports Disciplines for the purpose of three percent (3%) Horizontal Reservation in direct recruitment.
11. ii. The eligibility criteria, based on the tournament & medals, for the Senior level competitions of sports for employment are listed at Serial No. VII of this order.

(Contd....Pg.3)

-3-

iii. For filling up of posts which are: -

a. under the purview of the Andhra Pradesh Public Service
Commission (APPSC), the achievements (Individual &
Team) of the meritorious sportspersons shall be
considered as per the eligibility criteria indicated at Serial
No. VII of this order.

b. posts that are not covered under Group - I, II&III
services under the purview of APPSC, and those that are
outside the purview of the APPSC i.e., to be filled either
by the concerned Department, or any Selection Board, or
District Selection Committee (DSC), will be considered as
per the priority as listed in Serial No. VIII of this order.

d. The meritorious sportspersons must possess the requisite academic,
physical standards, age limit criteria, prior experience, and technical
qualifications, etc., as prescribed in the rules of the concerned
department governing such posts, in Direct Recruitment.

e. In respect of the posts related to physical education and sports
training, such as Physical Education Teachers (PET), Coaches, the
requirement of essential qualification(s) like B.PEd, Diploma in
Coaching (NIS Regular) etc., will be temporarily relaxed for
appointment under sports quota. This temporary relaxation is intended
to strengthen the sports education and training in such institutions by
the meritorious sportspersons. However, such selected candidates
appointed under sports quota, shall acquire the required qualification,
within a period, not exceeding five years from the date of appointment
to such post.

f. The three percent (3%) sports quota reserved for eligible meritorious
sportspersons shall be filled in accordance with the priority criteria
outlined in Serial No. VIII of this order.

g. The meritorious sportspersons who are eligible for a particular category
of posts, shall be considered as eligible for posts in lower categories
also, subject to the fulfilment of specific conditions that shall apply to
such posts but not vice versa.

Example: A sportsperson who is eligible for the posts in Group-I
services will also be eligible for the posts in Group-II &
Group-III services.

## II. Role and responsibilities of the Recruiting Departments

a. The concerned Department shall set apart such number of vacancies to
be filled up by eligible meritorious sportspersons through horizontal
reservation, without competitive examinations, and shall
simultaneously communicate the same to the Sports Authority of
Andhra Pradesh(SAAP).

(Contd....Pg.4)

-4-

1. b. While communicating the indents to the Sports Authority of Andhra Pradesh (SAAP) for filling up of vacancies through direct recruitment under three percent (3%) horizontal reservation for meritorious sportspersons, the department concerned shall not assign roster points. They shall indicate the number of vacancies to be filled up, along with the beginning and the ending roastor point of such vacancies.
3. c. In case, the department notifies not less than 33 vacancies, it shall reserve one(1) vacancy for the eligible meritorious sportsperson. Similarly, if the number of vacancies is not less than 66, two (2) vacancies shall be reserved for the eligible meritorious sportspersons. Further, if the number of vacancies is not less than 100, three (3) vacancies shall be reserved for the eligible meritorious sportspersons. 33 1/3% horizontal reservation shall be applicable for eligible women meritorious sportspersons. This exercise shall be conducted duly following the 3% horizontal reservation for meritorious sportspersons.
5. d. In the event, the number of vacancies notified by a department is less than 33, to meet the adequacy requirement that arises out of 3% horizontal reservation for meritorious sportspersons, the department shall communicate all the roaster points from beginning till the ending roastor points of such vacancies.
7. e. Simultaneously, the Department shall communicate the remaining vacancies (other than sports quota) to the recruiting agencies / selection boards such as Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC)/ District Selection Committee (DSC), for issue of notification to fill those vacancies by direct recruitment.
9. f. In the event of non-availability of any eligible meritorious sportsperson for a particular post earmarked to be filled under the 3% horizontal reservation for the meritorious sportspersons, such post shall stand lapsed.
11. g. A candidate appointed under sports-quota should be adjusted in the direct recruitment against the category viz. OC/SC/ST/BC/EWS to which he/she belongs.

## III. Role and responsibilities of Sports Authority of Andhra Pradesh
(SAAP)

a. On receipt of the indents from the department concerned, to fill up the
vacancies earmarked for the eligible meritorious sportspersons, the
Vice Chairman and Managing Director, Sports Authority of Andhra
Pradesh (VC & MD SAAP, shall issue a public notification in the leading
newspapers (Telugu and English) in the state by inviting the
applications from the eligible meritorious sportspersons for the posts.
The details of vacancies, qualifications, and other terms and conditions
shall be mentioned in the said notification.

b. The forms in which the applicant shall submit his meritorious sports
achievement, along with her/his application, are enclosed as Annexure
appended to this order.

(Contd....Pg.5)

-5-

1. c. In response to the notification, all the applications received by SAAP
2. within the stipulated time, shall be scrutinized by the Screening
3. Committee constituted for this purpose. The composition of the
4. Screening Committee

6. Members - Two Senior District Sports Development Officers
7. (DSDOs) (nominated by VC & MD, SAAP)

9. Member - Senior Coach, SAAP(nominated by VC&MD,SAAP)
10. Member - Assistant Director (Technical), SAAP
12. Any other member may be co-opted as deemed fit by the Chairman.
13. d. The Committee shall undertake the following:-
14. i. To verify as to whether the certificates have been awarded by a
15. competent authority as specified in Serial No. IXof this order.
16. ii. To ascertain the genuineness of the documents from the issuing
17. body.
18. iii. To assess the level at which the applicant has participated (e.g.,
19. State, National, or International).
20. iv. To verify the medals / participation in the competitions / place
21. achieved by cross verification of additional documents such as
22. photographs, official notices, press releases of the event,
23. participants involved, and line up certificates.
24. v. The date of the birth, as mentioned in valid certificate produced
25. by the applicant, shall be tallied proportionately to the category
26. of age group vis-à-vis the concerned sport.
27. vi. The date of birth shall be determined as follows :-

29. certificate, the date of birth (DoB) mentioned in the
30. certificate should be considered valid.
31. b. In the absence of certificate issued by a Board, the
32. certificate issued by the competent authority of the
33. "School" only i.e., schools run by autonomous
34. organizations like Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan (KVS),
35. Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS), Central Tibetan
36. Schools Organisation (CTSO), Sainik Schools Society etc.,
37. which are not affiliated to CBSE but are recognized by the
38. respective State Education Departments shall be
39. accepted as proof of age. The certificate issued by any
40. Sports Association or other body will not be accepted as
41. valid proof of age.
42. vii. The personal credentials of the sportsperson provided on the
43. application, birth certificate, and the sports certificate shall be
44. the same.

(Contd....Pg.6)

-6-

viii. To verify as to whether the organization that issued the sports
certificate is recognized by the appropriate sports governing
body. Certificates from unrecognized or unaffiliated
organizations shall not be considered valid for
employment purposes. The said certificates shall be considered
as invalid.

1. e. The Screening Committee shall prepare a preliminary merit list, and it
2. shall be published in the official website of SAAP to invite objections, if
3. any, within 7 days from the date of publication.
5. f. All such objections received within the stipulated time shall be
6. examined by the Screening Committee, and disposed of, duly
7. recording the reasons within the stipulated time.
9. g. The Screening Committee shall prepare a preliminary merit list of the
10. eligible meritorious sportspersons against the number of posts to be
11. filled according to the horizontal reservation.
13. h. The SAAP shall complete the process of finalizing the merit list of
14. eligible sportspersons within 30 days from the last date of receipt of
15. applications, as specified in the SAAP notification, from the interested
16. eligible meritorious sportspersons.
18. i. The merit list shall be communicated by VC &MD, SAAP to the State
19. Level Committee (SLC) immediately.

## IV. Role and responsibilities of State Level Committee
Composition of State Level Committee (SLC)

a. The composition of the State Level Committee shall be as follows:

a. The composition of the State Level Committee shall be as follows:

i. Chairman : Special Chief Secretary/Principal Secretary/
Secretary to Government, YAT&C(Sports &
Youth Services) Department.
ii. Member : Special Chief Secretary/Principal Secretary/
Secretary to Government (Services & HRM),
General Administration Department.
iii. Member : Special Chief Secretary/Principal Secretary/
Secretary to Government of the concerned
Recruiting Department.
iv. Member-Convener: The Vice Chairman & Managing Director,
SAAP, A.P., Vijayawada.

b. The VC & MD, SAAP shall convene the State Level Committee meeting
immediately on receipt of the preliminary merit list and place the said
list before the State Level Committee.

c. The State Level Committee shall review the department-wise, cadre-
wise vacancies earmarked to be filled under the 3% horizontal
reservation for the eligible meritorious sportspersons.

(Contd....Pg.7)

-7-

1. d. The Committee shall review the preliminary merit list, as submitted by
2. the Screening Committee, to satisfy itself that the list has been
3. prepared in accordance with the rules stipulated for this purpose.
4. e. The Committee shall complete the exercise within a time period, not
5. exceeding15 days from the date of receipt of the preliminary merit list
6. from VC & MD, SAAP.
7. f. The final merit list of eligible meritorious sportspersons for each of the
8. earmarked posts will be approved by the State Level Committee (SLC)
9. and such list shall only be valid for that specific notification.
10. g. The approved final merit list shall be communicated by the Convener of
11. State Level Committee, to the Recruiting agency such as APPSC/
12. Selection Board/ Department concerned / DSC.
13. h. The Recruiting agency shall integrate the final merit list, communicated
14. by the SLC, of meritorious sportspersons for implementing the
15. horizontal reservation in their merit list.
16. i. The final merit list approved by the State Level Committee shall be
17. final.

1. V. Other guidelines and general conditions
3. a. Participation at a higher-level tournament shall be considered only when it is supported by winning medals at the lower-level tournament for Individual events only. For Team games, participation at a higher-level tournament shall be considered, atleast, when it is supported by participation (not winning medal) at a lower-level tournament. For this clause, participation certificates, as applicable, need to be produced by the candidate.
5. b. If, at any point of time, it comes to the notice of the Competent Authority, that a sports certificate was issued fraudulently by any Sports Association/Federation, necessary legal action against such Sports Association / Federation shall be taken.
7. c. Forms issued by Sports Federation/Associations, other than those recognized by the Ministry of Sports and Youth Welfare, Government of India / Sports Authority of India/ Sports Authority of Andhra Pradesh, shall not be considered.
9. d. Sportsperson recruited against sports quota shall be terminated from service, if the information and documents furnished by him/her for recruitment, are found to be invalid /fake / obtained by fraudulent means, at any stage, as per the rules in vogue.
11. e. Every candidate, at the time submitting his application, shall be required to submit a declaration in the prescribed format that all the documents filed as a part of his application are true to the best of his knowledge and belief and further that such candidate shall be liable for criminal / disciplinary action, if a violation is noticed by the competent authority.
13. f. The candidates appointed to a Department under sports quota, shall represent such Department for at least 10 years from the date of appointment in sports competitions to be conducted at State, National and International levels.
14. (Contd....Pg.8)

(Contd....Pg.8)
